meta_description: Heritage Plastering & Rendering Services in Birmingham. Expert interior and exterior plastering, rendering, and finish work. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: From patching cracks to full exterior renders, we deliver smooth, durable finishes that last.
services_heading: Complete Plastering & Rendering Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: Whether it's interior finishing, external rendering, or specialist repair work, we've got the expertise and materials on hand.

services.title: Interior Plastering
services.desc: Smooth walls and ceilings, artexing removal, and feature finishes. We prep, plaster, and paint to a standard that makes your rooms look immaculate.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Durable exterior renders protect your home and transform its appearance. We use quality materials and proven techniques to resist Birmingham's weather.

services.title: Crack Repair & Patching
services.desc: Hairline cracks, settlement damage, or impact holes — we assess, prepare, and make invisible repairs that blend seamlessly.

services.title: Lime Mortar & Heritage Work
services.desc: Period properties need specialist care. We work with traditional lime mortars and period-correct renders to preserve authenticity.

services.title: Textured & Decorative Finishes
services.desc: Pebbledash, tyrolean, polished plaster, and bespoke effects. Add character and protection to any surface.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Plastering
services.desc: Retail, warehouse, and office fit-outs. We work to schedule, minimise downtime, and deliver commercial-grade finishes.

about_pullquote: Honest work, fair prices, finishes you'll be proud to live with.
about_para_1: Heritage Plastering was founded on a simple principle: do the job right, and do it right the first time. With over 15 years' experience across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, we've built our reputation on attention to detail and reliable, straightforward service. Every project — whether a small patch or a complete external render — gets the same level of care and craftsmanship.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we turn up on time, explain what we're doing, and leave sites clean and tidy. We're not interested in cutting corners or upselling unnecessary work. Instead, we focus on solving your problem honestly and fairly, which is why so many homeowners and local businesses call us back year after year.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Heritage Plastering

reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic work. Had my entire front rendered and Paul was brilliant from start to finish. Very professional, kept the area tidy, and the finished render looks immaculate. Would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Came out to repair some bad cracks in my lounge ceiling. Not only did he fix them perfectly, but he also spotted a potential damp issue and didn't charge extra to point it out. Top bloke. Very honest.
reviews.author: Linda C.

reviews.text: Had Heritage do our external render after we'd had a dodgy job done elsewhere. Paul completely sorted it, explained everything clearly, and the price was fair. Brilliant local tradesman. Already recommended him to three neighbours.
reviews.author: David P.
